t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The previous player stated that the orange, green, red, and blue hats on the gnomes, represented the gnomes represented the gnomes that would bring the higher numbers of mushrooms, out of each pair, regardless of mushroom multiplying number, and also the gnomes hat positions had no effect on the amount of mushrooms collected.

vb_textbox.text: I was advised by the player before me that regardless of the multiplier, to always choose the Red, Green, Blue, and Orange gnomes. I also found the brightness of the forest, and the colour of the basket had no impact on the scoring of the game, but it was factual. I did stick to the advice I was given, but on some of the occasions I made mistakes I did get some very high scoring mushrooms. I was also advised that the position of the gnomes, and the differences of their hats did not effect the outcome of the game, which I did follow so I could concentrate on the colour of the gnomes, and the speed of the game. Over the length of the full game I did choose to ignore the advice a couple of times after I had a few low scoring mushrooms in a row but I reverted back to following the advice given within a few selections. I also got a score over 2000 mushrooms overall, good luck.
